tagline: A leading publicly traded investment management firm
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is the primary revenue driver for BlackRock, as management fees are based on a percentage of assets under management. It is the fundamental KPI of the company's business model.
company_description: BlackRock, Inc. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm primarily provides its services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors including corporate, public, union, and industry pension plans, insurance companies, third-party mutual funds, endowments, public institutions, governments, foundations, charities, sovereign wealth funds, corporations, official institutions, and banks. It also provides global risk management and advisory services. The firm manages separate client-focused equity, fixed income, and balanced portfolios. It also launches and manages open-end and closed-end mutual funds, offshore funds, unit trusts, and alternative investment vehicles including structured funds. The firm launches equity, fixed income, balanced, and real estate mutual funds. It also launches equity, fixed income, balanced, currency, commodity, and multi-asset exchange traded funds. The firm also launches and manages hedge funds. It invests in the public equity, fixed income, real estate, currency, commodity, and alternative markets across the globe. The firm primarily invests in growth and value stocks of small-cap, mid-cap, SMID-cap, large-cap, and multi-cap companies.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of investments managed by BlackRock on behalf of its clients.
kpis.description: AUM reached $14.0 trillion at the end of 2025, driven by bull markets and new investment inflows.
kpis.signal: Strong growth supported by market performance and client flows

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from asset management and technology activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased to $24.2 billion in 2025, supported by higher AUM and the integration of HPS.
kpis.signal: Marked rebound following a decline in 2024

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined in 2025 after peaking in 2024, impacted by costs related to the HPS acquisition.
kpis.signal: Margin compression due to post-acquisition integration costs

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for BlackRock worldwide.
kpis.description: BlackRock now employs 24,900 people, reflecting its international expansion and recent acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Ongoing expansion to support global growth

kpis.name: Technology Revenue (Aladdin)
kpis.explanation: Revenues from technology platforms such as Aladdin, eFront, and Preqin.
kpis.description: Technology revenues show strong momentum, estimated at approximately $3.2 billion in 2025, driven by Aladdin and recent acquisitions (Preqin, eFront).

kpis.name: HPS Contribution
kpis.explanation: Annualized revenue contribution from HPS following its acquisition in July 2025.
kpis.description: HPS added approximately $1.8 billion in annualized revenue and strengthens BlackRock's position in private credit. The acquisition closed on July 1, 2025.
kpis.signal: Successful integration of a major private credit player

kpis.name: Long-term Net Inflows (trim)
kpis.explanation: Measures the net amount of money clients entrust to BlackRock over the long term, a key indicator of its growth and attractiveness.

kpis.name: Operating Margin Adj.
kpis.explanation: Measures the percentage of profit BlackRock generates after deducting operating costs, excluding non-recurring items.

kpis.name: Adj. EPS
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share: reflects BlackRock's underlying profit per share, excluding non-recurring items.

kpis.name: Alternatives Fee-Paying AUM
kpis.explanation: Measures assets managed in alternative products (hedge funds, private equity) generating fees for BlackRock.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid out, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $5.73 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $3.347 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 60.3% in the latest year.

kpis.name: AI Integration in Aladdin
kpis.explanation: Increasing use of artificial intelligence in the Aladdin platform for risk analysis and decision-making.
kpis.description: In 2025, 40% of Aladdin's core functionalities incorporate AI modules, up from 30% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Clear acceleration in AI adoption within core tools

kpis.name: Private Markets AUM
kpis.explanation: Assets under management invested in private markets, including infrastructure, private credit, and related solutions.
kpis.description: Private Markets AUM reached approximately $165 billion with the acquisition of HPS ($165 billion in acquired client AUM). This significant increase reflects the integration of HPS and GIP.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth driven by HPS and GIP

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate profit per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Market Volatility
risks.summary: Price movements in equity, bond, commodity, and other asset markets could reduce the value of AUM, investment returns, and trigger client redemptions.
risks.score_rationale: Clearly identified as the first risk in Item 1A Risk Factors. Direct impact on AUM and fee-based revenues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Intensified competition in the asset management industry may lead to lower revenues, margins, and market share for BlackRock.
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive industry. Risk mentioned in the context of fee pressure and product strategies. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.summary: Geopolitical risks, trade tensions, and tariffs could negatively impact the global economy and financial markets, thereby affecting BlackRock's operations.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'geopolitical unrest, terrorist activities, civil or international hostilities, wars, global trade tensions, tariffs'. Impact on global markets. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputational Damage
risks.summary: Damage to BlackRock's reputation could lead to loss of client trust, redemptions, and lower revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Critical for an asset manager reliant on fiduciary client trust. 'Damage to BlackRock's reputation' explicitly listed. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Climate and Environmental Risks
risks.summary: Climate-related risks could impact client portfolios, investment opportunities, and BlackRock's overall operations.
risks.score_rationale: Cited as both an operational and portfolio risk. 'Climate-related risks to BlackRock's business, products, operations and clients' identified in forward-looking statements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Artificial Intelligence Management
risks.summary: Failure to effectively manage the development and use of AI could result in operational errors, compliance risks, and loss of technological competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk specifically cited as 'the failure to effectively manage the development and use of artificial intelligence'. Growing importance for the Aladdin platform. (default score, to be refined)

risks.summary: Liquidity risks could limit BlackRock's ability to meet client redemptions or manage positions under volatile market conditions.
risks.score_rationale: Relevant for an asset manager overseeing variable-size products and diversified client mandates. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: BlackRock recognizes the development and use of artificial intelligence as a key element of its future strategy. The 10-K identifies 'the failure to effectively manage the development and use of artificial intelligence' as a significant risk, indicating active integration of AI into operations and products, particularly Aladdin. However, no quantifiable metrics on AI adoption or contribution are provided in the document.
evidence: MD&A Risk Factors: 'the failure to effectively manage the development and use of artificial intelligence' listed as key forward-looking risk
Aladdin platform highlighted as central to technology innovation strategy
Preqin and eFront acquisitions (2025) focused on data and analytics capabilities supporting AI-driven decision-making
